```{r}
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

# 1. Clean data
penguins_scatter <- penguins %>%
  drop_na(bill_length_mm, flipper_length_mm, species)

# 2. Color palette
penguin_colors <- c("Adelie" = "#FF8C00", "Chinstrap" = "#9932CC", "Gentoo" = "#008B8B")

# 3. Build the graphic
ggplot(penguins_scatter, aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = flipper_length_mm, color = species, shape = species)) +
  # Linear model trend lines per species
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm", 
    se = FALSE, 
    linewidth = 1.2, 
    alpha = 0.8,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # High-contrast styled points
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.75) +
  # Map manual color and shapes
  scale_color_manual(values = penguin_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 18)) +
  # Professional labels
  labs(
    title = "Penguin Bill vs. Flipper Dimensions",
    subtitle = "Distinct biological clusters emerge across Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo species",
    x = "Bill Length (mm)",
    y = "Flipper Length (mm)",
    color = "Species",
    shape = "Species",
    caption = "Data: Palmer Station LTER | Graphic via tidyverse"
  ) +
  # Apply base theme
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  # Custom styling
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "sans", color = "#222222"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 19, margin = margin(b = 6)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "#555555", margin = margin(b = 22)),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "#888888", margin = margin(t = 15)),
    
    # Elegant legend placement at the bottom
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#FDFDFD", color = "#EAEAEA", linewidth = 0.5),
    
    # Soft, subtle gridlines
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#EBEBEB", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(22, 22, 22, 22)
  )
```
